QuestInfo.name: The Dark Lord's Trivial Problem 2
QuestInfo.0: The Dark Lord says that he has another little problem...
QuestInfo.1: Heed the Dark Lord's request to eliminate the #bStumps#k in order to gain his trust. A good place to find Stumps is in the Thief Training Center at the Kerning City Construction Site.
QuestInfo.2: You solved the Dark Lord's problem and gained more of his trust.
QuestInfo.summary: In #bCaution Falling Down#k, go to the Thief Training Center by NPC #bPower B. Fore#k and eliminate Stumps.

0.0: Oh, and do you think you can do one more favor for me? The #bStumps#k are starting to cause some problems. They are typically docile, but once in a while they get themselves into trouble.

yes.0: Please go teach those Stumps a lesson. If you go to #bCaution Falling Down#k, you'll see #bPower B. Fore#k, who helps low level Thieves. He'll let you into the Thief Training Center, where you'll be able to find the #bStumps#k.

no.0: I was just starting to feel comfortable with you. Now, I am quite disappointed.

1.0: Have you taken care of them already? You are stronger than I expected.

yes.0: I look forward to your future development. Please continue to work on behalf of the thieves.

mob.0: It looks like you haven't taken care of the #bStumps#k yet. Is this too difficult of a job for you?
